ab.honest.body: HIMER is in early Beta. The network exists and works technically. We do not yet have paying business clients. The first 12 months are about building contributor base and proving the model. We are transparent: this is risk, not guaranteed income.
ab.honest.title: Honest about where we are
ab.label: — About
ab.lead: The compute economy is broken. We are building an alternative — one device at a time.
ab.mission.body: Make anyone with a computer a cloud provider. Make computing affordable for everyone. Build it transparently — without scams, without false promises.
ab.mission.title: Our mission
ab.problem.body: Cloud computing (AWS, GCP, Azure) is expensive, centralized, and inaccessible to small developers and researchers. Meanwhile, billions of personal devices sit idle. That unused power, combined, exceeds every datacenter. It is wasted.
ab.problem.title: The problem
ab.solution.body: HIMER turns idle devices into a global supercomputer. Contributors share unused capacity. When platform launches, businesses rent that capacity through a simple API at a fraction of cloud prices. Revenue split 60/40 platform/contributors.
ab.solution.title: Our solution

home.cta.lead: Join the Beta. Earn credits daily. Be among the first when platform launches officially.
home.cta.title: Ready to help build the network?
home.faq.a1: Honest answer: during Beta (12+ months) you will NOT receive money. You accumulate credits. When the platform launches with paying business clients, credits become redeemable at a rate determined by real revenue. Minimum withdrawal $500. If the platform never launches, credits have zero value. We are transparent about this risk.
home.faq.a2: It will be set at launch, based on real economics. We CANNOT promise 1:1 conversion — that would bankrupt the platform. Realistic estimate: 1 credit = $0.0001 to $0.001 depending on revenue. Power users get 2x bonus for first 1,000 active contributors.
home.faq.a3: Estimated Q4 2026 — when the platform launches officially with KYC, legal entity (SRL Estonia), and paying business clients. Minimum 12 months from now. Could be longer if growth is slow.
home.faq.a4: Transaction fees (bank wire, crypto gas) plus KYC verification costs make smaller withdrawals economically unviable. Power users active 12+ months should reach $500 easily.
home.faq.a5: Yes. The browser agent runs in a fully isolated WebAssembly sandbox. It cannot read your files, history, cookies, passwords, webcam, or microphone. Only processes anonymized compute packages. Source code on GitHub for audit.
home.faq.a6: Only CPU/RAM/bandwidth metrics. NOT files, NOT history, NOT passwords, NOT cookies, NOT camera/microphone. The sandbox physically cannot escape its container. This is the same model used by Folding@home and BOINC for 20+ years.
home.faq.a7: Display ads (Google AdSense) and optional reward video ads. Users never pay anything. We use ad revenue to fund platform development. When platform launches with business clients (Q4 2026), revenue model shifts to compute payments.
home.faq.a8: Yes, anytime. Close the tab, contribution stops instantly. Accumulated credits remain in your account. Account deletion available via Privacy page — credits are forfeited if you delete.

priv.collect.body: Minimal, by design. We store: anonymous device fingerprint, capacity metrics (CPU/RAM/bandwidth — never content), performance statistics, and credit accumulation history. If you provide an email, it's used only for notifications. We do not sell or share data.

priv.contact: Privacy questions, legal inquiries, security disclosures: himer.nodes@gmail.com

priv.lead: Full transparency about what we collect, what we don't, and your rights.
priv.rights.body: You can request data export or full account deletion at any time. Email himer.nodes@gmail.com — data removed within 30 days. No lock-in.
priv.rights.title: Your rights (GDPR)
priv.security.body: WebAssembly sandbox isolation. Only signed compute packages execute. HTTPS everywhere. Bcrypt password hashing. JWT sessions. Open-source agent for full transparency.
priv.security.title: Security
priv.title: Privacy & Legal Notice
priv.tos.body: By using HIMER Beta, you agree to: (1) Credits are loyalty points, not currency, and have no guaranteed monetary value. (2) Minimum withdrawal $500, available only after platform launches with paying business clients (estimated Q4 2026). (3) HIMER reserves the right to adjust credit acquisition rates and conversion ratios based on platform economics. (4) You may stop contributing and delete your account at any time; credits are forfeit upon deletion. (5) HIMER is operated as a private project until legal entity is registered (estimated month 6). Full Terms of Service will be published before any monetary transactions.
